summary: The paper provides a comprehensive, exact, and machine-verified classification of walled-Brauer B_3,1(d) Choi-splitting for U(d)-covariant product maps in quantum entanglement theory. It establishes the exact rational reduction over Z[d], proves a sharp universal dimensional barrier d_min = 8 via continuum dual Farkas certificates, constructs a universal closed-form quadratic polynomial family for all d >= 8, establishes a certified sqrt(d) depth scaling ladder up to d = 256, and uncovers an exact d = 4 rank-2 separable-mixture gap demonstrating that the dimensional restriction arises purely from the rank-1 product constraint. All results are fully verified in Lean 4 and an AST-audited zero-float verifier.
